weighted-hc3.quantity: Weighted coefficients, HC3 covariance matrix and slope sign.
weighted-hc3.tolerance: rtol = atol = 2e-5 in float32 or 2e-11 with x64 enabled. Slope sign agrees exactly.
weighted-hc3.boundary: Eight observations, nonuniform positive weights and a full-rank intercept/slope design. Reference receives the same quantized inputs.

poisson-exposure.quantity: Coefficients, fitted means and in-sample predictions with offset and exposure.
poisson-exposure.tolerance: rtol = atol = 1e-4 in float32 or 1e-6 in float64.
poisson-exposure.boundary: Twelve counts with positive exposures. The comparison concerns a converged fit on this design.

affine-gmm.reference: scipy.linalg.lstsq and a NumPy empirical moment sandwich
affine-gmm.quantity: Fitted coefficients and covariance after rescaling one moment derivative by 0.001.
affine-gmm.tolerance: rtol = 2e-5 in float32 or 2e-11 with x64 enabled. Coefficient atol = 0 and covariance atol = 1e-10.
affine-gmm.boundary: Exactly identified two-parameter affine problem, four moment observations, identity weight and plain long-run covariance.

bartlett-hac.quantity: OLS sandwich formed from STATADIC's uncentered Bartlett meat after restoring its sample-size scale.
bartlett-hac.boundary: Eight float64 observations, bandwidth two and no finite-sample correction. The test fixes the bandwidth.

holm-decisions.reference: Independent sequential Holm step-down loop in the test module
holm-decisions.quantity: Boolean rejection decision at every hypothesis, including ties.
holm-decisions.boundary: Generated lists of one to twelve dyadic p-values, alpha 0.125. Null validity of the input p-values is a separate scientific assumption.

powered-transport-dual.quantity: Native rooted cost raised back to p versus dual objective, reduced costs and complementary slackness.
powered-transport-dual.tolerance: Objective rtol = 2e-6 and atol = 0. Slack is at least -1e-10 and the mass-times-slack absolute tolerance is 1e-10.
powered-transport-dual.boundary: Uniform masses on a 3 by 3 cost matrix with repeated rows at p = 1, 2, 3.

finite-energy.quantity: Scalar Euclidean empirical V-energy for exponents 0.5, 1 and 1.5.
finite-energy.boundary: Uniform empirical laws with unequal counts and repeated atoms. The U-statistic and population moment conditions require separate evidence.

capped-simplex.quantity: Simplex weights, objective, and reported first-order gap against an independent constrained fit.
capped-simplex.tolerance: Weight atol = 2e-7 with rtol = 0. Objective absolute tolerance 2e-9. Observed excess may exceed the reported gap by at most 1e-10.
capped-simplex.boundary: Five weights and a seeded PSD quadratic with a linear term, using upper bounds 1.0 and 0.3.
